sources.title: Core AI | Apple Developer Documentation
sources.snippet: The Core AI debug gauge and Core AI instrument help you monitor and profile inference performance in your app. You can also compile models ahead of time with the coreai-build command-line tool. If your app uses model types other than neural networks, such as decision trees or tabular feature engineering, see Core ML.
